# Week 8 Start/Sit Briefing — Saturday, 2026-10-31

## Source and freshness

**Fixture is current, one game already final.** `weekly-report-week-8.json` was generated 2026-10-27T15:36:33Z, confirmed as the right week by `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` and by `load_schedules()`, which shows only Thursday's CAR@GB has been played -- every other Week 8 game (12 on Sunday, 1 on Monday) is still ahead. Live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` for Week 8 now carries 320 rows across 28 of 32 teams -- essentially the full final report. Of this roster's teams, only LAR (Stafford), IND (Taylor) and DEN (bench Bo Nix) haven't filed, and none of those three carry a designation in the fixture either, so that's just those teams' normal reporting pattern, not a gap to worry about.

Two things the live data adds beyond the fixture: Atlanta's now-complete 18-player report does **not** include Drake London, who the fixture still carries as Questionable (head) -- that's the standard signature of a player cleared off the injury report, not one still pending. And Jalen Coker's Thursday game is done: 2 catches on 5 targets for 36 yards and a touchdown, plus a lost fumble -- 9.60 real points under league-2's scoring, used here in place of the fixture's pre-game 9.75 estimate.

Also resolved since the last briefing: the kicker hole that cost this lineup ~8 points for three straight weeks is closed. Jake Bates (DET) was rostered 2026-10-29, replacing bye-week Dominic Zvada.

## Start these ten — 138.57 expected points

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | vs LAC (Sun 4:05pm ET) | **17.10** | 97.2% | 17.60 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs JAX (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **16.61** | 95.4% | 17.40 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs ATL (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **15.33** | 95.4% | 16.06 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @CHI (Mon 8:15pm ET) | **23.30** | 96.9% | 24.03 |
| WR | Drake London | @TB (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **15.20** | 90.4% | 16.82 |
| TE | Sam LaPorta | vs MIN (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **10.51** | 94.7% | 11.10 |
| FLEX | Jalen Coker | @GB (FINAL: 27-19 loss) | **9.60** | 100% | 9.60 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | vs TEN (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **15.61** | 96.8% | 16.13 |
| K | Jake Bates | @MIN (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **8.19** | 98.5% | 8.31 |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | vs LV (Sun 1:00pm ET) | **7.12** | 100% | 7.12 |
| **Total** | | | **138.57** | | |

Bench: Jameson Williams (WR, 12.04, trails started Higgins by 3.6 points), Bo Nix (QB, 15.46, behind Stafford's 17.10). On bye this week (NYG/NO), unavailable regardless of projection: Tyler Shough (QB), Cam Skattebo (RB), Isaiah Likely (TE).

**No changes recommended. This is a confirm-the-lineup week.** Every starting slot clears its bench alternative by a comfortable margin, and the one close call from earlier in the week (FLEX1, Coker vs. Williams) was already decided and played before this report ran.

## Changes since Wednesday

- **Kicker hole closed.** Jake Bates (DET) replaces the bye-week Dominic Zvada, rostered 2026-10-29 -- the fix this report has been naming since Monday finally landed, and it's worth the full 8.19 points back into the lineup.
- **FLEX1 was decided Thursday, before this report, and it's already final.** Wednesday's briefing had Jameson Williams narrowly ahead of Jalen Coker on the model (12.04 vs 10.52). The owner's own roster note explains going the other way: Sleeper's own number favored Coker by a wider margin on target-share, and Coker's last-three-game profile (volume-driven) was read as a better match for this matchup than Williams' recent long-TD-dependent output against a Minnesota defense that graded as this week's top unit. Coker played, caught the garden-variety volume (5 targets) but also lost a fumble; net 9.60. There's nothing to recommend here now -- it's in the books.

## Watch list

- **Drake London** -- still tagged Questionable (head) in the fixture, but Atlanta's complete Week 8 report doesn't list him, which reads as cleared. Started regardless either way (no real WR2 alternative); worth a final glance at Sunday's inactives list purely for confirmation, not because the start/sit call would change.
- **Stafford / Taylor / bench Nix's teams (LAR, IND, DEN)** haven't filed an injury report at all this week. No designation anywhere for any of them in the fixture, so this is almost certainly just those teams' normal low-report-volume pattern -- but check Sunday's pregame inactives list before the early kickoffs regardless.

## Opponent notes

- **Bucky Irving (TB) and Drake London (ATL) play each other** Sunday 1:00pm ET -- both start regardless, just a notable crossover.
- **Sam LaPorta and Jake Bates are both Lions**, both starting, both at Minnesota Sunday 1:00pm ET -- correlated, not conflicting: a good Detroit script helps both.
- **Jaxon Smith-Njigba's game is the last lock of the week** (Monday 8:15pm ET @CHI) -- the only player on this roster whose situation could still change after Sunday's games are all played. Nothing currently flags him; worth a final look Monday afternoon before the late lock.
- Jets D/ST has a normal Week 8 matchup (vs LV) -- no bye, nothing to flag.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 8 (this week):** Tyler Shough (QB), Cam Skattebo (RB), Isaiah Likely (TE) -- all bench, no lineup impact since none of them would otherwise start.
- **Week 10:** Bucky Irving (RB, TB) -- a clear starter, so this needs a real replacement plan (Skattebo is the obvious bench answer, assuming he's healthy by then) rather than just a bench swap. Bench Bo Nix (QB, DEN) is also on bye that week, but Stafford (bye Week 11) covers QB regardless.
